title: Army Continuing Medical Education (CME) Reaccreditation
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > MEDCOM > W40M USA HCA
description: The Office of the Army Surgeon General, Medical Education Directorate (MEDED) has formal oversight of Continuing Medical Education (CME) for Medical Corps (MC) Officers. The Contractor shall provide guidance to the Continuing Medical Education staff regarding the Army’s adherence to the Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education (ACCME) Requirements. The contractor shall provide consultative assistance and recommendations for the U.S. Army Medical Command (MEDCOM) and MEDED to attain the goal of a six-year reaccreditation.
